Name: Buildable Bathhouse
Author: KhloeLeclair
Description:
This mod adds a new bathhouse that Robin can build for you. Go for a nice relaxing soak without ever leaving your farm!

Requires Content Patcher and Stardew Valley 1.6 as of release 2.0. Solid Foundations is no longer required.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/13746/13746-1662918428-1083025789.png[/img]

Downloads.Description: The old version that works on Stardew Valley 1.5. Requires Solid Foundations.
